name: Barrel of Laughs

start.dialog: Bet you can't fit in a barrel! Everyone says 'Bob, you're crazy!' But YOU? You look FLEXIBLE! Borrow my spare barrel - wear it for ONE HOUR in the bazaar! Prove 'em wrong!
start.objective: Wear a barrel in the Dustbelt Bazaar for one hour

progress.dialog: Still in the barrel? GOOD! People are TALKING! The barrel life CHOOSES you now! Embrace it!
progress.objective: Continue wearing the barrel and interact with 5 NPCs

complete.dialog: HA! You DID it! They said it couldn't be done! BARREL-BUDDIES! Here - my LUCKY barrel ring! Won my first barrel race with this! Now it's YOURS!

party_comments.kade: I am NOT getting in a barrel.
party_comments.twist: I want a barrel too! Barrel twins!
party_comments.nix7: This is... illogical. Yet statistically entertaining.

hidden_outcome: If you wear the barrel for 3 hours total, you unlock the 'Barrelman' title and Bob teaches you the 'Barrel Roll' dodge technique
